name: Checkout.com API
tagline: Global payments API for cards, wallets, and local methods
description: Checkout.com provides a unified REST API for accepting and managing payments across cards, digital wallets, and local payment methods. Merchants use it for authorization, capture, refunds, payouts, and risk controls with sandbox and production environments.

auth.details: Secret API key via Authorization: Bearer header (or channel access key for some flows); sandbox and production keys from Dashboard.
